summary: Comprehensive and well-structured test suite covering all core requirements. Unit tests thoroughly exercise the cleanup logic (max age, keep-latest-N, max total size, combined policies, error handling). Workflow structure tests validate YAML and actionlint compliance. Act integration tests provide valuable end-to-end validation with exact-value metric assertions, ensuring the pipeline runs correctly. Strong TDD structure with clear Describe blocks, helper fixtures (New-TestArtifact), and deterministic reference dates. Weaknesses: missing edge cases around invalid inputs (negative values, future dates), hardcoded expected metrics in act tests create brittleness, no performance testing, and Docker/act dependency adds brittleness to integration tests. Would reliably catch functional regressions but may miss subtle input-validation or performance issues.
